title: AI Solutions Architect | AI Adoption & Delivery
summary: AI solutions architect and consultancy founder focused on turning business needs into deployed systems and practical AI adoption. Led delivery of 120+ GenAI applications and 90+ AI chatbots for 30+ clients. At Assent, increased internal AI adoption from 47% to 97% and delivered $1.7M+ in operational savings. Combines solution architecture, stakeholder coordination, enterprise workflow automation, and hands-on education with a background in software project management.
